claims.claim_text: Indexed Bernadotte E. Schmitt is strongly linked to historian Bernadotte Everly Schmitt of the University of Chicago.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The distinctive exact name and middle initial align with an institutional finding aid that explicitly documents his 1943-1945 OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from a distinctive exact name, expanded middle name, profession and explicit OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: The finding aid places his OSS service in 1943-1945 and his university appointment across 1924-1946.
claims.match_notes: The civilian P-8 index row is consistent with the documented professor and OSS historian; the personnel file remains unreviewed.

claims.claim_text: Bernadotte E. Schmitt's University of Chicago professorship continued through the start of his OSS service.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional chronology dates the professorship to 1924-1946 and OSS work to 1943-1945.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity based on the distinctive exact name and explicit OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded overlap establishes the university as a continuing immediate affiliation; recruitment from it is not asserted.
claims.match_notes: The source directly supplies both date spans. The project does not infer an exclusive employer or employment termination at OSS entry.

claims.claim_text: The University of Chicago is the best-supported last civilian employer for Bernadotte E. Schmitt before and during his wartime OSS work.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: His documented university appointment spans the pre-OSS and OSS years, with no intervening civilian employer identified in the reviewed chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity based on the distinctive exact name and explicit OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded; the appointment continued through OSS entry, but the source does not call it the exclusive employer.
claims.match_notes: This category is kept separate from the immediate-affiliation claim even though the same documented appointment supports both.

claims.claim_text: Indexed First Lieutenant Robert J. Schmitz is confirmed as the OSS officer profiled in the May 3, 1944 arrival report.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official OSS report agrees in exact name and a nonshared protected identifier and supplies a continuous Army-to-OSS chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact full name and a matching nonshared protected identifier retained only in the private database.
claims.temporal_assessment: The report was created during Schmitz's OSS service and recounts his 1942-1944 military chronology.
claims.match_notes: The report calls him a second lieutenant; the later first-lieutenant index rank is treated as a plausible promotion, not a conflict.
